summary: Iteration 3 (email delivery, uploads, PDF export, backup/restore) — full backend + frontend verification. All 51 backend pytest cases pass (16 new for iter-3 + 35 regression from iter-1/iter-2). All frontend E2E flows for image upload (student logbook, avatar), coordinator PDF button and admin Backup/Restore verified end-to-end. Fixed one critical missing import in App.js that was preventing the entire app from mounting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1195 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth/users/uploads/reports/admin) for maintainability.

GET /api/uploads/file/{id} authenticates via cookie only; image tags CAN send cookies on same-origin, so this works. But cross-origin (frontend on different domain than backend) image loads would fail because tags don't set withCredentials by default. In this deployment the preview URL is same-origin so it works.

POST /admin/restore is destructive (delete_many + insert_many per collection). Recommend a transaction OR a safety flag to prevent accidental clobber. Currently protected by admin RBAC + browser confirm() only.
Backup dump has no schema/version marker — restoring an old backup against a newer schema could silently insert bad docs.
email_service surface: unable to verify inside Docker but end-to-end response confirms email_sent=true for gmail.com and false for example.com as spec'd.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/App.js (CRITICAL FIX: added missing `import AdminBackup from '@/pages/admin/Backup'` — without this, /app/admin/backup route referenced an undefined component causing 'AdminBackup is not defined' ReferenceError that crashed the entire React app on every route)
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed users (TEST_es_, TEST_rt_, real.sup+iter3 gmail alias, TEST_sup_, etc.) plus uploaded PNG files remain in DB from Playwright + pytest runs. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: 51 tests (~24s). test_iter3.py covers: (1) email delivery — coordinator create supervisor on gmail.com => email_sent=true; on example.com => email_sent=false but user still created with temp password; (2) uploads — POST /api/uploads/logbook + /api/uploads/avatar return {id,url starting with /api/uploads/file/,content_type}, bad scope=>400, bad ext=>400, GET download returns exact bytes with correct content-type, unauth=>401; (3) PDF — /api/reports/summary.pdf as coordinator+admin returns %PDF magic + attachment header, student=>403; (4) backup/restore — GET /api/admin/backup returns JSON with created_at + 12 collections, non-admin=>403; POST /api/admin/restore with invalid JSON=>400, non-admin=>403, and full round-trip (create user → backup → delete user → restore → user is back). Frontend E2E confirmed: log-image-upload widget shows preview + saves image URL + entry renders with image; avatar-upload attaches (hidden input, use state='attached' when writing selector) and after save+reload sidebar aside contains ; download-pdf opens new tab (browser PDF viewer, url may appear as 'about:blank' initially but the underlying API returns 200 %PDF); admin sidebar has 'Backup & Restore' link with Cloud icon; backup-download / restore-input / restore-btn present; restore round-trip via UI shows 'Last restore' panel with 12 collections and doc counts.

rca_of_the_issue: CRITICAL FIX APPLIED — /app/frontend/src/App.js had a Route element `<AdminBackup />` on line 90 but the corresponding `import AdminBackup from '@/pages/admin/Backup'` was missing. Because JSX is compiled to `React.createElement(AdminBackup, ...)`, the reference was evaluated on every render of the App tree (not lazy), which threw `ReferenceError: AdminBackup is not defined` on ANY route including /login. Result: the entire React app was crashing before mount and showing a blank page. Fix: added the missing import. This unblocked all frontend testing (login page rendered normally after the fix).
